brief:
Medical teams evacuated 41 patients from Gaza on Thursday for treatment outside the strip through the Rafah border crossing in the south, according to Shehab Wire. The Palestinian Red Crescent Society said its personnel participated in the evacuation operation.

The evacuation comes as Gaza continues to face an acute medical crisis, with healthcare resources severely strained and patients unable to access necessary treatment within the territory.
dek: Medical teams evacuated 41 patients from Gaza on Thursday for treatment outside the strip through the Rafah border crossing in the south, according to Shehab Wire.
title: Medical teams evacuate 41 patients from Gaza for treatment abroad
